row.evidence: TINYpulse documents no SCIM endpoint; its Entra ID integration is a vendor-run group sync ('users will sync automatically into TINYpulse') and SAML SSO is set up through support.
row.notes: TINYpulse is now sold by WebMD Health Services (tinypulse.com redirects to webmdhealthservices.com); quote-only, no public plans (Request demo). No SCIM in the help centre, API reference or IdP catalogues checked. User automation is vendor-run, non-SCIM: Entra ID group sync (daily on weekdays, removes users missing from synced groups), Google Workspace new-user detection with manual invite, and HRIS syncs (Workday weekly, BambooHR, UKG, Dayforce, Namely). SAML SSO (Okta, OneLogin, Entra, PingFederate) is configured by support; plan gate not published. The public API is read-only (surveys, responses, cheers, receivers) and an add-on on most subscriptions. Okta OIN app is SWA only.

plans.name: TINYpulse (quote-only)
plans.notes: No public tier table; the API is an add-on on most subscriptions and is read-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented; Searched the help centre and API reference.

capabilities.notes: The OpenAPI spec lists only GET endpoints (surveys, responses, cheers, suggestions, segments, receivers); no user write operations.

limitations.text: The API is an add-on to most subscriptions and is aimed at extracting feedback data.

user_api.notes: Read-only analytics API; not a user-management API.

entra.notes: Vendor-run Entra ID group sync from TINYpulse Settings > Integrations; SAML SSO set up separately via support. No Entra gallery tutorial found on Microsoft Learn.

google.notes: Detects new Google Directory users for an admin to invite; no automatic deprovisioning described.

onelogin.notes: From the vendor's OneLogin guide (TINYpulse SAML app).

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run Entra ID group sync; Google Workspace new-user detection; HRIS integrations (Workday weekly, BambooHR, UKG, Dayforce, Namely).
fallbacks.notes: CSV uploads are sent to support and loaded in a few business days. SAML users must still be invited (no JIT documented).
